mapper.select: select id, account_id, theme, theme_color, font_size, sidebar_collapsed, guide_completed, create_time, update_time from user_settings where account_id = #{accountId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert ignore into user_settings (account_id, theme, theme_color, font_size, sidebar_collapsed, guide_completed) values (#{accountId}, #{theme}, #{themeColor}, #{fontSize}, #{sidebarCollapsed}, #{guideCompleted})
mapper.update: update user_settings set theme = #{theme}, theme_color = #{themeColor}, font_size = #{fontSize}, sidebar_collapsed = #{sidebarCollapsed}, update_time = now() where account_id = #{accountId}
update user_settings set guide_completed = #{guideCompleted}, update_time = now() where account_id = #{accountId}
